brief.narrative: A hundred-wide mouth cut clean through the park deck, lined fifteen courses deep with a collar that darkens as it falls and carries a corbel at its foot, ringed by a nine-wide gallery, and overhung by eight balconies that oversail the void on their own brackets. A lit return column stands at the centre, floor to rim, which is the spine the descent winds around.

fun_contract.outcome: From any balcony the whole descent is visible at once, hanging free thirty blocks clear of the collar; from under the park the mouth is a lit ring in the belly with a helix falling out of it.
